summary: Clarifies schema-7 linked attach and resume, interactive panels and owner-verified member discovery for Termbrio 0.5.12.

changes.text: Author schema-7 Team files and keep schema-6 inputs as attach-default normalization. Show the optional linked startMode: resume setting with an owner-policy YAML example.

Remove contradictory claims that linked members can never be resumed. Distinguish explicit Team-start restore from attach-only show, view dispatch and reconnect; local Team stop never stops linked members.
Explain interactive linked panels and explicit read-only viewing without granting lifecycle ownership or bypassing owner input and pairing policy.
Document canonical owner-verified one-hop member discovery, unavailable peer results and the separation between linked terminal start mode and provider conversation action.
Requires Termbrio 0.5.12 or newer. Product and plugin versions remain independent; no provider hook behavior is changed by this release.
